svg.text: DeepSeekMoE: one token picks 4 of 16 experts
plus one shared expert · each expert is a SwiGLU 384 → 256 → 384 · our code runs all 16 and zeros the grey ones
① sigmoid score per expert, computed in float32
④ gate-weighted sum + shared → 384 numbers back to the stream
Real router output for "the" in "The fog came in off the" (MoE layer 3): experts 0, 7, 8, 15, out of 1,820 possible teams.
